title: The Frog Prince
summary: A sad child loses a toy in water and makes a deal with a frog.

sentences.text: Once upon a time, a young princess lived within the limestone walls of a magnificent castle situated near the edge of a deep, ancient forest.
Her days were frequently spent wandering the royal grounds, her attention entirely captivated by her most treasured possession, a perfectly spherical golden ball.
On a particularly warm summer afternoon, she sought the coolness of the deep royal fountain, tossing her prized toy high into the air and catching it as it fell.
In a moment of catastrophic miscalculation, the glittering sphere slipped past her outstretched fingers, tumbling deep into the dark, churning water until it vanished completely.
The inconsolable child sank to the mossy stones, weeping bitterly over the sudden and seemingly permanent loss of her favorite companion.
While her lamentations echoed through the trees, a peculiar amphibian with slick green skin emerged from the murky depths of the water.
He hoisted himself onto the stone rim, inquiring gently as to why her delicate features were so thoroughly marred by grief.
Through tearful breaths, she confessed the fate of her golden ball, prompting the creature to offer an immediate and unconditional rescue of the toy.
However, the amphibian demanded a heavy toll for his labor, insisting that he be permitted to enter the castle, dwell in its halls, and dine from her golden plate.
Desperate to recover her lost treasure without delay, the princess readily agreed to every demand the strange creature set before her.
True to his word, the little green animal plunged back into the dark water and swiftly returned with the gleaming golden sphere.
No sooner had the toy been placed upon the grass than the ungrateful girl snatched it up and bolted toward the castle without a backward glance.
She slammed the heavy oak door behind her, instantly erasing any memory of the promise she had made mere moments before.
Later that evening, as the royal family gathered for supper, a soft, deliberate tapping sounded against the massive entrance doors.
When the king's daughter pulled the door open, she recoiled at the sight of the green amphibian waiting patiently upon the threshold.
She attempted to bar the door against him, but her observant father noticed her distress and demanded an explanation for her bizarre behavior.
Upon learning of the bargain struck at the fountain, the stern monarch declared that a royal promise must never be broken under any circumstances.
Reluctantly, the miserable girl admitted the creature into the grand hall and permitted him to share her private dining table.
When they had finished their meal, the amphibian requested to accompany her upstairs and sleep upon her embroidered pillow in the quiet bedroom.
Overwhelmed by a sudden surge of blind fury and utter exhaustion, she seized the creature by his slippery limbs and hurled him forcefully against the stone wall.
Before he struck the hard masonry, a blinding flash of light enveloped the little animal, transforming him instantly into a remarkably handsome young man.
He explained with calm dignity that a wicked enchantress had trapped him in the form of a lowly water creature for many long years.
Only the steadfast commitment of another person, demonstrated through the honoring of a difficult vow, could ever hope to break the heavy spell.
Realizing the depth of her error and the surprising grace of her companion, the princess felt her heart soften toward him profoundly.
They forged a deep bond through countless hours of conversation, eventually realizing that their lives were forever intertwined within the safety of the castle walls.
Every morning thereafter, the sun illuminated the tall castle towers while songbirds filled the ancient forest with sweet, harmonious melodies.
Life within the royal household grew remarkably peaceful, characterized by genuine joy and mutual respect between the newly formed couple.
Citizens from the surrounding town frequently traveled up the winding road to catch a glimpse of the king and his remarkably content family.
The young man never truly forgot his time spent as a cold, green amphibian at the bottom of the royal fountain.
Whenever he gazed out over the dark water, he reflected on the vital importance of honesty and integrity in all human affairs.
The princess herself remained utterly faithful to her word, ensuring that no broken vows or dishonesty ever threatened their quiet happiness.
They shared every burden equally, supporting one another through unexpected challenges with patience and remarkable understanding.
Their friendship deepened with each passing year, radiating warmth and stability throughout every corner of the vast stone fortress.
Servants and kitchen workers alike held the couple in high regard, deeply respecting their humility and unfailing kindness toward everyone.
Whenever difficult situations arose in the kingdom, the pair invariably found a wise and compassionate solution together.
In time, the tale of the golden ball evolved into a beloved legend recounted by parents to their children across the entire land.
Everyone learned that true companions must cultivate absolute trust and maintain strict adherence to their spoken commitments.
The years slipped by quietly, leaving behind a wealth of cherished memories embedded firmly in the hearts of the castle inhabitants.
The young man and his wife spent their afternoons strolling through the green forest, discussing philosophy, nature, and their shared future.
Sometimes they sat quietly by the fountain edge, watching small fish dart beneath the shimmering surface of the water.
The aging king frequently observed the couple from his high window, smiling deeply as he witnessed their enduring devotion.
Every chamber of the castle echoed with laughter and music, ensuring that sorrow found no permanent home within those walls.
If a neighboring family fell upon hard times, the generous couple was always first to offer substantial aid and provisions.
Local children often played games near the water, secretly hoping to catch a glimpse of something magical beneath the ripples.
Whenever the young man and woman encountered these children, they gently reminded them that keeping one's promise is the most vital duty of all.
Decades passed smoothly, yet the affection between the couple never wavered even slightly as they grew gray together.
During long winter nights, they sat side by side before a roaring fireplace, recounting the strange adventures of their youth.
Their remarkable story was eventually inscribed into ancient leather-bound volumes so that future generations would never forget the lesson.
Travelers from distant realms arrived at the gates merely to hear the tale of how a broken vow led to an enduring union.
The grand castle stood proudly as a timeless symbol of truth, resilience, and the quiet power of kept promises.
They lived out their remaining years in complete tranquility, knowing they had navigated life with honor and genuine care.
The lingering memory of the little green animal remained with them forever, serving as a humble foundation for their happiness.
When the wind swept through the tall forest trees, its rustling sound mirrored the sweet songs of birds at dawn.
Though the world beyond the fortress gates was vast and unpredictable, their home remained their entire universe.
Requiring nothing more than each other's presence, they rested securely in a peace that endured for all time.
